sql: SELECT 'O' k, market_ticker, side, action, limit_price::text p, quantity::text q, status, created_at::text t, coalesce(cancel_reason,'') r FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND (status='resting' OR created_at > '2026-09-30 23:07') UNION ALL SELECT 'F', market_ticker, side, action, price::text, quantity::text, '', filled_at::text, '' FROM fills WHERE filled_at > '2026-09-30 23:07' AND market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1') ORDER BY 1,8
